messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up — Polaris private/VPC dry-run scheduled TOM 09:00 PT. We need final checks on: egress to their SIEM (splunk.polaris.internal), runtime IAM (least-priv), KMS key usage for envelope encryption + rotation cadence, and audit log forwarding + retention. Anything blocking?
Ravi Menon: Egress rule pending in their firewall request. They opened ticket POL-462 but staging team hasn't approved the rule for prod-preview.
Keiko Sato: IAM-wise the runtime role is missing kms:GenerateDataKey for the envelope flow. I drafted an inline policy but want security to vet scoping.
Jamal Ortiz: KMS owner asked for explicit key grants instead of broad role ARNs. They want to use a Grant with constraints. I can prepare a grant example but need the monitor role ARN.
Elena Park: Good to know. We should avoid blanket grants; prefer scoped grants. Also Polaris asked for 180-day retention by default for audit logs (their compliance team). That's longer than our standard 90d — heads up for billing/retention note on the health sheet.
Ravi Menon: Working the firewall approval. I proposed: allow TLS to splunk.polaris.internal (10.12.7.90) from priv-subnet-a/b on port 443. I'll paste the ACL snippet once done.
Keiko Sato: Here's the minimal IAM snippet I suggested for runtime: ```
Effect: Allow
Action: ["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"]
Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888888:key/alias/polaris-enc
Condition: {"ForAnyValue:StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "999999999999"}}
```
Jamal Ortiz: Grant example I'll propose: ```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/polaris-enc --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/polaris-monitor --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"purpose":"audit"}
```
OnboardBot: dry-run-report-3234500000: last dry-run had 2 checks failing: audit-forwarder (connect timeout) and key-access (permission denied). Run id: a1c2d3.
Elena Park: That aligns with current blockers. Ravi, can you escalate the firewall ticket to get the egress rule into prod-preview before 6PM PT today? Policy team needs the prod-preview test for the audit-forwarder.
Ravi Menon: Escalated to Polaris infra. Ticket POL-462 -> status: in-review -> assigned to infra-eng@polaris. I'll post updates.
Keiko Sato: I'll open a minimal PR for the runtime role with the exact actions and resource and tag @security for quick review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/polaris-onboard/pull/22
Jamal Ortiz: I posted the grant template in the policy repo and asked Polaris for the monitor role ARN. Link: https://gitea.redwood/keys/polaris-grants/45
Elena Park: Action list for health/renewal scoring: 1) get egress rule applied -> reduces immediate go-risk. 2) merge runtime IAM PR + confirm KMS grant -> fixes key-access failure. 3) drop audit-forwarder proof (logs-tail) into runbook for compliance sign-off -> addresses retention ask. If those land we mark account health as green and low renewal risk.
OnboardBot: note: dry-run attempt scheduled at 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z.
Ravi Menon: Firewall rule approved in staging and prod-preview scheduled. Rule id: acl-p-7782. Verified connectivity test to 10.12.7.90:443 passed from priv-subnet-a. :white_check_mark:
Keiko Sato: PR merged and security approved scoping. Added runbook snippet with verification steps: ```bash
# verify key access
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://cipher.bin --key-id alias/polaris-enc
# tail audit logs
aws logs tail /aws/audit --filter-pattern "polaris" --start 1h
```
Jamal Ortiz: Polaris provided monitor role ARN: arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/polaris-monitor. Created grant and posted grant-id g-0a1b2c. Requested Polaris confirm they can decrypt sample envelope.
Elena Park: I'll run the focused dry-run at 09:05 PT and update the customer health sheet after. Keiko — please add a troubleshooting table showing the exact failures users saw (connect timeout, kms:AccessDenied) to the runbook to speed TAT.
Keiko Sato: Adding troubleshooting table now. Also adding retention note (180 days) and billing impact line item.
Elena Park: Excellent. If the dry-run is green we'll schedule the enablement session with Polaris ops next week and close onboarding tasks. Thanks team! :tada:
